findings.text: validate_node refuses a node that names no manifest path, and that refusal is what fails 14 tests across tests/test_a_named_anchor_is_not_preloaded.py and tests/test_queue_dag_waits.py at the dispatch base and identically at the head (logs/baseline-callers.log vs logs/callers-of-the-rebuild.log, 14 FAILED ids each, delta 0). Section 36's done_when states those two files pass at the head, and the reviewed manifest records outside_scope: none, so a reader is told a condition held that does not; reproduced on current main too, so it is pre-existing and outside this node's write scope, but the coordinator must not write the done_when back as met.

_json_ready's docstring promises 'The collections are copied rather than shared so a reader of the serialised node cannot mutate the node it came from', but a list is copied shallowly, so the dicts inside admission_findings - a field this change newly serialises - are shared with the node; mutating as_dict()['admission_findings'][0]['detail'] on a real TaskNode changed the node's own list, so the stated guarantee is false for the one field that carries nested data.

_stored_field_value copies a stored list shallowly, so the rebuilt node's admission_findings entries alias the pointer dict they were read from; the same defect as node.py:748 in the reverse direction, and no added assertion fails if either copy is removed.
